title: Along the Lash Line
caption:
Beauty Note — No. 12
Along the Lash Line

Every look asks for its own line.
But in my sessions, there is one I return to most.

Just above the lashes.
Not filling the gaps between them —
a fine line, resting close along the top.

At the outer corner,
the tail runs straight out, perfectly level,
about the length of your lashes.

Where the lines meet, soften them into one.

To me, it is the most natural line of all.

atelierR Personal Makeup Session
Japan / Singapore / Sydney
